scope: Original Graal Online Classic 1.8 ARM64 libqplay.so

functions.name: THTTPRequest_sendRequest_void
functions.role: Builds a connector request, configures the native socket, and starts the connection.

functions.name: TSocketConnection_enableSSLOnSocket_void
functions.role: Creates or reuses the CyaSSL context, loads trust data, configures verification, and starts the nonblocking TLS handshake.

functions.name: TSocketConnection_setStatus_int
functions.role: Transitions the socket state and starts TLS when a connected socket reaches status 5.

functions.name: TSocketConnection_checkConnecting_void
functions.role: Polls a pending nonblocking connect and checks SO_ERROR.

functions.name: TSocketConnection_connectSocket_TString_const_int
functions.role: Creates an IPv4 TCP socket, makes it nonblocking, and begins connect.

functions.name: TSocketConnection_setEnableSSL_bool
functions.role: Changes the SSL request flag and attempts the SSL transition.

functions.name: TSocketConnection_setSSLVerifyCert_TString_const
functions.role: Stores the native trust string and enables certificate verification when it is nonempty.

functions.name: TSocketConnection_sendData_void_const_int
functions.role: Writes through CyaSSL when TLS is active and records TLS errors.

functions.name: TSocketConnection_read_void
functions.role: Reads through CyaSSL when TLS is active and closes on terminal errors.

state_summary.status_4: TCP connect pending. checkConnecting uses a zero-timeout select on the write set and can leave the socket pending when it is not ready.
state_summary.status_5: TCP connect completed. setStatus calls enableSSLOnSocket when the SSL flag is enabled.
state_summary.tls_gate: enableSSLOnSocket returns unless the descriptor exists and the state is status 5. It then loads the trust buffer, configures verification and hostname checking, enables nonblocking CyaSSL I/O, and calls CyaSSL_connect.
state_summary.status_2: A nonzero SO_ERROR from the pending-connect check closes the socket and enters the failure state.
state_summary.status_7: closeSocket frees the CyaSSL object, closes the descriptor, and records the closed state.

diagnostic_order: Confirm the app reaches its loading and timer loop.
Confirm that a TCP connection is attempted.
For a status-4 socket, observe the zero-timeout select and SO_ERROR result.
Only after status 5, inspect the TLS ClientHello, trust-buffer load, hostname check, and certificate result.
If TLS fails, inspect the documented mode-3 cleartext fallback separately.
runtime_relation: The earlier local ARM64 emulator control reached a TLS listener, sent no HTTP request for an expired trust input, and then exercised the mode-3 fallback. That proves the TLS-stage failure control but does not exclude a separate status-4 stall caused by a render or timer loop that never performs the pending-connect poll.
source: IDA Pro decompilation and cross-references from the active 1.8 ARM64 database.
